description: The "XYZ123 - Copy" table contains patient admission information, including demographics, admission and discharge details, insurance, and diagnoses. The table's primary key is HADMID (Hospital Admission ID). It also includes information on emergency department registration and departure times, an expiration flag indicating in-hospital mortality, and a flag indicating the availability of chart data. This table is likely used for analyzing patient demographics, admission patterns, and outcomes.

columns.name: SJID
columns.description: Subject ID: Unique identifier for each patient or subject in the dataset.

columns.name: HADMID
columns.description: Hospital Admission ID: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMTM
columns.description: Admission Time: Date and time when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DCTM
columns.description: Discharge Time: Date and time when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DTHTM
columns.description: Date/Time of Death: Date and time of patient's death, if applicable.

columns.name: ADM_TP
columns.description: Admission Type: The type of admission, such as 'EMERGENCY', 'ELECTIVE', or 'URGENT'.

columns.name: ADM_LOC
columns.description: Admission Location: The location from which the patient was admitted (e.g., 'EMERGENCY ROOM ADMIT', 'TRANSFER FROM HOSP/EXTRAM').

columns.name: DSC_LOC
columns.description: Discharge Location: The location to which the patient was discharged (e.g., 'SHORT TERM HOSPITAL', 'LONG TERM CARE HOSPITAL', 'HOME').

columns.name: INSR
columns.description: Insurance: The type of insurance the patient has (e.g., 'Government', 'Self Pay').

columns.name: LANG
columns.description: Language: The primary language spoken by the patient.

columns.name: MAR_STS
columns.description: Marital Status: The patient's marital status (e.g., 'SINGLE', 'MARRIED', 'DIVORCED', 'WIDOWED').

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Emergency Department Registration Time: Date and time when the patient was registered in the emergency department.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Emergency Department Out Time: Date and time when the patient left the emergency department.

columns.name: DIAG
columns.description: Diagnosis: Patient's diagnosis during the admission.

columns.name: EXP_FLG
columns.description: Expired Flag: A binary indicator (0 or 1) indicating whether the patient expired during the admission (1) or not (0).

columns.name: HAS_CHRT_DATA
columns.description: Has Chart Data: A binary indicator (0 or 1) indicating whether the patient has chart data available (1) or not (0).
